items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I went, I saw him, they were playing a parade for a club, Jolly Bunch. He was a little short fellow, but he couldn't do it.

ctx.x: I think you're still the only one.
Yeah. It seemed like one day I heard Dave Bailey once, the little drummer of the band.

You know who was trying it once? I went, I saw him, they were playing a parade for a club, Jolly Bunch. He was a little short fellow, but he couldn't do it. It wouldn't be Abbey, would it? Abbey, yeah. And he had this same fellow playing bass drum with him, Booker T. Oh yeah. Yeah, yeah. They played for a club back at town there, the Jolly Bunch, they had a parade. I went back there to collect tax from them, and he tried it, but there was nothing to it.
